name: squadron-ai
description: Squadron is a template-driven code review framework that runs repeatable, structured LLM reviews from the terminal through the `sq` CLI. Each review executes a YAML-defined template against a diff, design document, or task plan and returns a verdict (PASS, CONCERNS, or FAIL) with severity-tagged findings. Beyond reviews it orchestrates multi-step agent pipelines across multiple LLM providers, with event streaming, metrology, and an MCP/FastAPI server surface.
